title: E: cache_control on fixed system prompts in AnthropicLLM; cache tokens and savings recorded in Budget
summary: AnthropicLLM sends system prompts >=512 approx tokens as a cache_control block; Budget gains cache_write_tokens/cache_read_tokens/saved_usd; anthropic_usage_cost prices cache writes 1.25x, reads 0.1x (0.05x opus/sonnet 5.5), batch 0.5x on top of Nathan's PRICES_PER_MTOK. tests/test_llm_cost.py
